facts.fact: FAO says a national cocoa-mapping project in Cameroon, funded by the EU, uses satellite data to identify cocoa production zones, and a 16-18 July 2025 Ebolowa workshop trained 50 participants including ministry representatives on SEPAL and Google Earth Engine.
facts.system: Cartographie du cacao au Cameroun et caractérisation de son impact sur les forêts

systems.system: Cartographie du cacao au Cameroun et caractérisation de son impact sur les forêts
systems.owner: FAO with EU Programme Cacao Durable

CMR.note: Document states nothing on rules or authorities for AI harms.
AI is used for cocoa mapping by a FAO-run project, not stated as a government body's AI system in service or being tested for its administration.
The AI mapping is a FAO and EU project output, not stated as a tool in a public sector system.
AI mapping is done with foreign platforms by FAO; no locally built model, dataset or AI computing is stated.
Workshop was technical training; no consultation on a named digital law or policy is stated.
